name: vibe-vs-spec-demo
description: Demo project for 'Vibe Coding vs Spec-Driven Dev' talk

scripts.demo:reset: node -e "const http=require('http');const r=u=>new Promise((y,n)=>{const q=http.request(u,{method:'POST'},s=>{s.on('data',()=>{});s.on('end',y)});q.on('error',n);q.end()});Promise.all([r('http://localhost:3001/reset'),r('http://localhost:3002/reset')]).then(()=>console.log('✅ Both APIs reset — ready for demo')).catch(()=>console.log('⚠️  Could not reset — are both servers running?'))"
